Texas Senate Race Tightens Amid Republican Support for Paxton

The Texas Senate race is tightening, with Republicans reportedly betting on Elon Musk's financial support to aid Ken Paxton. A Fox News poll indicates the race is heading towards a close finish, described as a "photo finish." Firstpost and Reuters coverage also notes the competitive nature of the race, with Firstpost highlighting a clash between veterans in New Hampshire's Senate race, though this appears to be a separate event from the Texas focus.
